entities.name: Jedhian
entities.description: A deceased inhabitant of Inys Haen, descendant of Haen and cousin of Aylith, who helped resist the Nohrish invasion.

entities.name: Inys Haen
entities.description: Jedhian's homeland, invaded by the Nohrish.

entities.name: Aylith
entities.description: Jedhian's cousin, captured by the Nohrish.

entities.name: Keeper Logan
entities.description: Keeper who perished in the fires set by Thix.

entities.name: Selka
entities.description: Logan's wife, who perished in the fires.

entities.name: Thix
entities.description: Set the fires that killed Logan and Selka.

entities.name: RoNal
entities.description: A disgraced prisoner infected with the walking plague who sacrificed himself so Jedhian could escape.

entities.name: Lorris
entities.description: RoNal's daughter, who teamed up with Jedhian.

entities.name: Arn
entities.description: A crippled slave who teamed up with Jedhian.

entities.name: Nazir
entities.description: A captive Lorris wanted to execute, who later fled captivity.

entities.name: Malvos
entities.description: A Nohrish figure Jedhian was forced to heal.

entities.name: Soulslayer
entities.description: A long-lost blade Jedhian unknowingly wielded, destroyed when he healed Malvos.

entities.name: Crephas
entities.description: Previous Felonarch who created the frog.

entities.name: the frog
entities.description: A monstrous amalgamation of man and dark magic in the dungeon pit.

entities.name: Clan Tree of Cridhe
entities.description: The Clan Tree restored after the Awakening Ritual.

entities.name: Awakening Ritual
entities.description: The ritual that restored balance and mended the Clan Tree.

entities.name: Inys Nohr
entities.description: The Nohrish land from which Jedhian and allies fled.

events.summary: Jedhian buries Aylith's mother and sets out after the Nohrish captors to rescue Aylith.
events.quote: Jedhian, determined to rescue his cousin Aylith , set out in pursuit of the Nohrish captors

events.summary: Jedhian's rescue attempt fails and he is imprisoned with RoNal.
events.quote: His initial rescue attempt failed, resulting in his capture and imprisonment

events.summary: RoNal sacrifices himself so Jedhian can escape the frog.
events.quote: RoNal sacrificed himself, allowing Jedhian to escape and continue his mission.

events.summary: Jedhian, Lorris and Arn orchestrate a flight from Inys Nohr amid a growing rebellion.
events.quote: Jedhian helped orchestrate a desperate flight from Inys Nohr amid a growing rebellion

events.summary: Jedhian stops Lorris from executing Nazir, urging mercy.
events.quote: Jedhian stopped Lorris from executing Nazir

events.summary: Taken by the Nohrish, Jedhian heals Malvos with his last magic, destroying Soulslayer and sealing his fate within Cridhe.
events.quote: he was forced to heal Malvos using the last of his magic

events.summary: Jedhian witnesses the Awakening Ritual that mends the Clan Tree and ends the war.
events.quote: Jedhian witnessed the Awakening Ritual that restored balance to the land

relations.quote: He was also cousin of Aylith .
a monstrous creature created by the previous Felonarch, Crephas
